about: The rules of spec/engine/decals.md: one shard of the BFBC2 tool suite specification's rule index, written by spec/trace.py --emit; checked by spec/trace.py --check.

evidence.ref: spec/probes/terrain.py, 2026-11-22: 30 DICE visual terrains, 1,424 strips; per-terrain 0 - 188; kinds by the shader name's last part; layers and second / mask shader counts as listed

rules.title: Roads and terrain decals are strips in the visual terrain

evidence.ref: OPFOR's Wake Island, 2026-11-12: 60 quad-decal strips cloned from shaders of other layouts drew as sheets across the sky until the strip donors were chosen by layout

rules.title: Strips draw on the strip layout, over the patches, reading the height map

evidence.ref: DECAL-STRIP-1 (world positions in the strip) and DECAL-SRC-1 (the sources are not in any bundle)

rules.title: A road edit rewrites the strips; nothing re-bakes them in game

evidence.ref: spec/probes/terrain.py, 2026-11-22: 30 terrain partitions: the class counts and references as listed; Enable true on every group, spline and quad decal, 280 of 314 full decals

rules.title: The terrain partition's decals are editor sources

evidence.ref: spec/probes/level.py, round SPV1 2026-11-22, DICE's 74 level partitions: TerrainSplineData 1,360, TerrainSplinePointData 14,449, TerrainSplinePlaneData 1,372 (all with the water fields), TerrainSplinePlanePointData 44,132 (all with WaterSpeed)
spec/probes/terrain.py, 2026-11-22: 74 DICE level partitions: the four spline classes' counts and fields as listed
spec/probes/materials.py, 2026-11-22: 19,730 MaterialRelationDecalData in DICE's grids, Decal set on 17,338

rules.title: Bullet and blast decals come from the material grid
